sources.entry: Soju - Run Battle.net, Diablo II: Resurrected and Steam games on Apple Silicon Macs with a fully free Wine stack built from GPL sources; one-line installer.

summary.one_liner: Soju is a free, open-source Mac game library and launcher for Apple Silicon that runs Battle.net, Steam, Epic and GOG GALAXY clients through a GPL Wine-based engine.
summary.what_it_does: Collects installed and owned games from Battle.net, Steam, Epic Games and GOG GALAXY into one native Mac library, where you can search, filter, favorite and launch them through their official Windows clients. Steam library import uses official sign-in, and GOG library import reads the cache from GOG GALAXY; Epic and Battle.net account imports are not yet included. A Discover view searches Steam and GOG listings and prices with links to the stores. The engine is built from CodeWeavers' published GPL Wine sources, and Apple's GPTK/D3DMetal is downloaded separately by the user. The README also describes a CLI (soju doctor, update, uninstall, and per-launcher commands) and per-launcher bottles, with a Platforms page for setup and diagnostics.
use_cases: play Diablo II: Resurrected on an Apple Silicon Mac
run Battle.net or Epic games on macOS
launch Steam games on a Mac without paid Wine tools
manage several game launchers in one library
compare game prices across Steam and GOG
set up a Wine bottle for GOG GALAXY on macOS
how_to_run: soju battlenet / soju d2r / soju steam / soju epic / soju gog
stack: Apple Game Porting Toolkit / D3DMetal (downloaded separately)
notable: Separate Wine bottle per launcher, so Steam and the CX-based engine stack do not interfere
Battle.net agent signature workaround (BLZBNTBNA00000005 fix) and a documented Rosetta AVX env var for D2R
Steam client runs on a pinned upstream Wine 11 build with a steamwebhelper wrapper
Installer asks which launchers to set up before downloading anything; SHA-256 verified Steam components
Detailed troubleshooting and diagnosis docs in the repo
caveats: Requires Apple Silicon, macOS, and a separately downloaded Apple GPTK; Diablo II: Resurrected needs macOS 26.4 or later
Games with kernel anti-cheat (EAC, BattlEye, Vanguard) will not run; compatibility varies by game and most titles are untested
Epic and Battle.net account imports are not included yet; GOG games not broadly tested
